short_description: Event operations & logistics across the U.S. and Mexico. IRONMAN · HYROX.
service_area_text: United States & Mexico — nationwide. Available for travel-based assignments, multi-city event schedules, touring event circuits and extended event deployments.
client_care_text: Fast-moving environments where logistics, timing, teamwork and problem-solving are critical. Background in real estate and security.
opening_hours_text: Available year-round for event schedules — contact me to check dates.
service_categories_text: Event Operations, Transportation & Logistics, Event Experience
services_text:
Event Operations:
On-Site Event Operations — On-site operational support for large-scale sporting, endurance, fitness and live events.
Site Build & Breakdown — Load-in, event build, course setup, teardown and load-out.
Course & Venue Infrastructure — Barricades, crowd-control barriers, traffic cones, course equipment, event signage, staging and temporary infrastructure.
Transportation & Logistics:
Heavy Commercial Transportation — Licensed to drive heavy commercial trucks: long-distance and event-to-event transport of equipment and infrastructure.
Event Logistics — Movement, coordination, deployment and recovery of event equipment, infrastructure and operational assets.
Equipment & Asset Deployment — Transporting, unloading, positioning, installing, recovering and reloading the equipment large sporting events need.
Event Experience:
IRONMAN — Event transportation, equipment logistics, site setup, course infrastructure, barricade deployment, load-in/load-out and breakdown for major endurance events in the U.S.
HYROX (incl. HYROX Mexico) — Event operations, build and breakdown, logistics, equipment deployment, venue infrastructure and on-site operational support.
featured_text: Open to Opportunities — Event Logistics Coordinator · Site Operations Lead · Build / Logistics Lead · Event Transportation & Logistics · Operations Manager – Build · Event Operations Manager. Let's work together.
faq_text:
Where is Cory available to work?
Nationwide across the United States and Mexico, and internationally as needed. He is available to travel for multi-city schedules and extended deployments.

Can he both drive the equipment and set it up?
Yes. Cory is licensed to operate heavy commercial trucks and works directly with the equipment after arrival — unloading, deployment and setup.

What events has he worked?
Major endurance and fitness events including IRONMAN in the United States and HYROX, including HYROX Mexico.
